name: Wendong Zhang
notes: Main source: Cornell CV PDF dated June 30, 2026. Included peer-reviewed economic, extension/engagement and interdisciplinary articles, 2 book chapters, and the CV's Working Papers section (R&R / under review). Skipped Choices Magazine pieces, Nature Food News & Views, non-peer-reviewed reports/bulletins, work in progress. Co-author names appear as initials as written in the CV; only Wendong Zhang is expanded. Where the byline has two 'W. Zhang' (JASFMRA 2018; PFAS working paper) I assumed the scholar is first/last respectively - ambiguity. Land Economics Wan et al. year set to 2025 (online 2025, CV lists under 2024). Book chapter years: Irwin et al. has no year in CV (2021 assumed from book publication, not verified); Nickerson and Zhang 2014. Working-paper years are the CV's dates. Teaching Appraisals paper only from homepage (SSRN 2026). Homepage-only items without bylines (dairy digester JDS Comm paper, AEEE, etc.) mostly skipped when not in CV. R&R status for papers with 'Revisions Requested'.
